console.scope:
Passive cycle boundaries for console CPU work and fenced drawing.

Elapsed routine time includes preemption and is an upper bound on its CPU time.
The launch-to-idle-read interval bounds hardware occupancy; it is not a BUSY-edge
measurement. Host screenshot/fixture Sleep intervals are outside these spans.

limitations: 40 ms first-scanout input target remains unmeasured.
20 ms scroll and 500 ms full repaint targets fail; last drawing fences alone exceed both limits.
Elapsed routine spans include preemption, not isolated Task CPU time. Launch-to-idle bounds include software service, not exact hardware BUSY edges.
Cold initialization Forbid intervals are excluded from the active-I/O 50 ms bound, explicitly recorded by the oracle.
Shared timer alarm deadlines measure acknowledged physical edges to armed SIO callbacks; pointer-only ticks retain their independent 1 ms sampling bound.
Existing cooked input has a 36-character visible editing tail; shell command history is unsupported.
Eight-Task stress uses cache=16 to force ongoing SDFS I/O; production demo uses cache=512, with five idle and seven pipeline Tasks.
No physical hardware or release qualification claim.
